name: Quota Manager
description: Function-level API quota tracker with atomic cycle-reset and consume. SQLite-backed, zero external dependencies beyond Python stdlib.
description_cn: 函数级 API 配额追踪器，支持原子性周期重置与消耗。SQLite 存储，Python 标准库零额外依赖。

directives.usage_cn: 配额;注册,<目标>,<周期>,<上限>
directives.description: Register a new quota rule for a target function. Cycles: day/week/month/year/forever.
directives.description_cn: 为目标函数注册配额规则。周期：day(日)/week(周)/month(月)/year(年)/forever(永久)。

directives.description: Atomic check and consume quota units. Returns remaining count or stop signal.
directives.description_cn: 原子性检查并消耗配额。返回剩余次数或停止信号。

directives.description: List all quota rules with current usage and remaining counts.
directives.description_cn: 列出所有配额规则及当前使用量、剩余次数。

directives.description: Manually reset a quota counter to zero.
directives.description_cn: 手动将配额计数器归零。
